acceptanceCriteria: Spec CEM-V1-082 and both consumers define concentratedHunks as 0 when maxFanOut is 1 (or document the degenerate case), with a shared vector and byte-identical blocks.
body:
Panel finding (eval-method). internal/cem/verify/support.go:196-207 counts a supported hunk as concentrated when every basis evidence ID is cited by exactly maxFanOut hunks. When maxFanOut is 1 every hunk qualifies: map 860f59ea reports concentratedHunks 156/156 although all 156 hunks cite distinct evidence. The portable consumer mirrors the same rule (byte identity is preserved, the measure is just meaningless).
Expected: concentratedHunks measures concentration on a shared umbrella item. Actual: it equals the supported-hunk count whenever no evidence item is shared.

title: cem citation: concentratedHunks is degenerate when maxFanOut is 1
